name: Opal
desc: Play-of-colour drifting across an opal — angular harlequin patches of pure spectral fire igniting one after another as a slow light band rakes over the milky silica, each fleck flashing its own colour then fading back into the opalescent body.

flecks.doc: number of play-of-colour patches across the stone — broad harlequin to fine pinfire

density.doc: flash breadth — low: sparse sharp pinfire, high: broad soft harlequin

scale.doc: patch scale — zoom into the fire

hue.doc: tint of the opal body / milky opalescence (spectral flashes stay full-spectrum)

speed.doc: how fast the light band travels and the stone rocks

x.doc: direction the light band sweeps across the stone

y.doc: vertical bias of the flashing band

style.doc: precious: milky white-blue body with vivid spectral flecks · black: near-black potch, most brilliant contrast · boulder: colour veins running through brown ironstone matrix · fire: warm honey-orange body with red and gold flashes

seed.doc: a new stone — fresh patch layout, colours and phases
